description: Unit test script for the Contract doctype in ERPNext, testing contract status and fulfilment logic.

classes.name: TestContract
classes.description: Unit test class for testing various contract statuses and fulfilment conditions.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment by clearing Contract table and creating a new contract document.

methods.name: test_validate_start_date_before_end_date
methods.description: Tests that start date cannot be after end date.

methods.name: test_unsigned_contract_status
methods.description: Checks default status of a newly inserted unsigned contract.

methods.name: test_active_signed_contract_status
methods.description: Verifies status when contract is signed and within active date range.

methods.name: test_past_inactive_signed_contract_status
methods.description: Checks status when contract is signed but past end date.

methods.name: test_future_inactive_signed_contract_status
methods.description: Checks status when contract is signed but start date is in the future.

methods.name: test_contract_status_with_no_fulfilment_terms
methods.description: Verifies fulfilment status when no fulfilment terms are set.

methods.name: test_unfulfilled_contract_status
methods.description: Checks fulfilment status when requirements are set but not fulfilled.

methods.name: test_fulfilled_contract_status
methods.description: Verifies fulfilment status when all requirements are marked as fulfilled.

methods.name: test_partially_fulfilled_contract_status
methods.description: Checks fulfilment status when only some requirements are fulfilled.

methods.name: test_lapsed_contract_status
methods.description: Verifies fulfilment status when contract is past its deadline.
